data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hazan' meaning 'grace', 'Hazen' embodies the divine blessings bestowed upon us by God. In Christianity, it is often associated with humility and faith. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hazen usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
